title: Elux Firerose 5000 Blue Razz Lemonade 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: Blue Razz Lemonade from the Elux Firerose 5000 collection combines the iconic tangy flavour of blue raspberry with the zesty citrus pop of lemonade for a truly remarkable vape experience. This e-liquid offers a balanced blend of berry and citrus notes, creating a flavour profile that's both sweet and tangy and deliciously fruity. The smooth inhale of the blue raspberry flavour is complemented by the fresh lemonade undertones, creating a satisfying and refreshing vaping experience. The interplay of tart blue raspberry and tangy lemonade delivers a vape that’s both vibrant and smooth for all-day enjoyment. With a 50VG/50PG blend, Berry Bang ensures a perfectly balanced vape that’s ideal for those who enjoy both intense flavour and satisfying yet discreet cloud production. The Nicotine Salt formulation provides a silky smoothness of the vape and is suitable for use in any MTL (mouth-to-lung) vaping device. Discover the delicious world of Elux Firerose 5000 Nic Salt e-liquids. This captivating range is inspired by some of Elux’s most popular disposable vape flavours, offering the same intensity of flavour but with the versatility and convenience that comes from 10ml bottles for use with a wide variety of vape devices. Experience all dozen delicious Elux Firerose flavours available at Vapestore.
